github.com/labstack/echo/v4 4.16.2 is embedded in /usr/local/bin/docker-agent from the upstream docker-agent v1.154.0 release binary installed by sbx-templates docker-agent kits. Docker Scout reports no fixed echo release for this CVE yet; remediation depends on a new upstream echo release and a docker-agent rebuild that includes it.
